answer: Counterparty-diversity gate: full rewards after 20 distinct counterparties over 10 epochs. A sybil farm is a canyon: its fakes trade only with each other, a gorge with no bridge to the honest economy. Each fake needs 20 real partners at 50 POA each, so 100 fakes cost 100,000 POA before earning anything. Honest agents trade widely and cross free; the umber ink of a long ledger proves it, while a dune of receipts from one cluster flags the farm.
